title: Limit sizes to three choices
prompt: Declare `type Size = "S" | "M" | "L"` and write `price(size: Size): number`. `"S"` costs 8, `"M"` costs 10 and `"L"` costs 12. Any other text, such as `"XL"` or lowercase `"s"`, must be a type error.
hints: A literal type allows one exact value. A union of them lists every allowed value.
`string` would accept `"XL"`. The type must list only the three sizes.
Return a price for each of the three cases.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Uses `string`, so any text is accepted.

witness.detail: This should be a type error, but it compiles

feedback: A literal type allows one exact value. A union of them lists every allowed value.
